name: Perfect Timing
source: In Perfect Timing, you step into the shoes of a famous musician who has achieved great success in the world of contemporary pop music. In the midst of recording your newest album, you receive a call from your landlord (changeable) and discover he’s been jailed. He implores you to abandon your current project and return home to look after your loved ones while he’s away.
